title: Oxoclusters of the Lanthanides Begin to Resemble Solid-State Materials at Very Small Cluster Sizes: Structure and NIR Emission from Nd(III)

material_class.structural_family: Nd12O6 oxo cluster with chalcogen/Hg encapsulants

synthesis.procedure: Under high-purity nitrogen using drybox/Schlenk techniques, Nd (2.0 mmol, 0.29 g), PhSeSePh (3.0 mmol, 0.94 g), and Hg (0.30 mmol, 0.06 g) were combined in pyridine (40 mL) and stirred until the metal dissolved (24 h) to give a dark forest-green solution of in situ Nd(SePh)3. Elemental Se (2.00 mmol, 0.158 g) and SeO2 (1.00 mmol, 0.111 g) were added; the mixture became greenish-black within 3 h and red-brown after stirring overnight. The solution was filtered, concentrated to ca. 25 mL, and layered with 10 mL of hexane to afford tiny yellow block crystals of Nd12 (0.44 g, 34%) that do not melt but turn dark red-orange at 236 °C.
synthesis.time: 24 h metal dissolution, then 3 h color change and overnight stirring
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk flask under nitrogen; drybox/Schlenk techniques
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, reduced in volume to ca. 25 mL, layered with 10 mL hexane; yellow block crystals
synthesis.yield: 0.44 g, 34% (also stated as 30–40% in the results text)

properties.summary: Nd12 shows NIR emission intermediate between highly emissive molecular Nd sources and nonemissive Nd2O3. Powder emission under 800 nm excitation gives bands at 926, 1082, and 1352 nm (4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2, 4I13/2); the 1832 nm band seen for Nd8 is absent. Fluorescence decay of the 1082 nm emission is 141 μs versus a calculated radiative lifetime of 1160 μs, giving 12% quantum efficiency. Absorption in THF (0.05 mM) resembles typical Nd3+ solid-state spectra. Intensity is limited by multiphonon relaxation from the Nd–O core, C–H overtones, and Nd–Nd concentration quenching.

measurements.name: NIR emission bands
measurements.conditions: powdered sample; 800 nm Ti:sapphire excitation of 4F3/2

measurements.name: fluorescence decay time (τ_fl)
measurements.conditions: 1082 nm 4F3/2 → 4I11/2 emission; Monte Carlo fit including cooperative Nd–Nd energy transfer

measurements.name: calculated radiative decay time
measurements.conditions: Judd–Ofelt derived radiative lifetime used with experimental τ_fl

measurements.name: absorption spectrum
measurements.value: Nd3+-like transitions with comparable absorption coefficients to solid-state Nd materials
measurements.conditions: THF solution, 0.05 mM (0.05 mmol stated in figure caption)
